---
applyTo: "src/data/**/*.ts,tests/catalog-integrity.test.ts,SOURCES.md,CHANGELOG.md"
---

- Every device identifier and OS build must be traceable to a public source.
- Keep exact Apple casing and punctuation; do not rewrite marketing names stylistically.
- Add only iPhone and iPad families in catalog updates.
- Preserve historical entries and unknown-value behavior.
- Treat corrections as user-visible changes and document them under `CHANGELOG.md` Unreleased.
